sources.summary: A Sunday morning Prom showcases the magnificent RAH instrument, but the organ’s not just for Bach – check out pioneering musicians from Jonny Greenwood to Kali Malone. Plus, Igor Levit is cancelled – and at the top of the German charts It has 9,999 pipes, it’s 155 years old and 21m high . You can see it, but not always hear it, at every single London prom. I’m talking of course about the Willis organ in the Royal Albert Hal l, which takes centre stage this weekend on Sunday morning’s recital by French organist Olivier Latry . With his mostly Bach programme, Latry’s recital represents the core of the organ’s repertoire, music that has been heard in cathedrals and on concert hall organs for centuries. It will be magnificent in the building-shaking flesh on Sunday morning, but my assurances might not be enough to convince non-organ fans that they should forgo a lazy Sunday morning and head to South Kensington.
